summary: SuperX AI Technology Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting a press release announcing that its subsidiary SuperX Microinference Pte Ltd signed an equipment and services supply agreement and received an initial purchase order from Australian compute service provider Ezisight Australia Pty Ltd for 128 units of B300 AI server clusters. The servers are scheduled for delivery in Q4 2026. This is a routine commercial contract announcement, not a special situation. It does not involve any M&A, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation event. The filing is a standard current report on Form 6-K for a foreign private issuer disclosing ordinary business developments.
